text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-2026-4897 — service=ratecap-mapper env=prod region=us-east1 metric=429_rate spike > 5σ. 3 unacked pages, escalation level: P1. PD link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-2026-4897

pagerduty: Incident INC-2026-4897 assigned to @sre-oncall (primary)

sre-oncall: Acked. Investigating. Noting customer impact: elevated 429s and some 500s. @alice-nguyen can you join? I'll pull the dashboards.

alice-nguyen: oncall joining. seeing sudden drop in quota mapping throughput -> quota-mapper pods reporting Liveness failures. cpu spikes then OOM in logs.

ben.kim: i rolled out a quota-mapper config at 12:00 that changed tenant routing table -> maybe malformed key. Reverting now.

lucas-g: logs show traceback in quota_mapper.main: KeyError 'tenant_id' during batch apply. looks like new mapper config didn't account for empty tenant header. snippet:
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/quota_mapper.py", line 312, in apply_batch
    tenant = batch['headers']['x-tenant-id']
KeyError: 'x-tenant-id'
```

alice-nguyen: ok mitigation options: 1) rollback deployment to previous revision 2) restart quota-mapper pods to shed bad config 3) flip limiter to fail-open for 5m so requests pass though.

sre-oncall: do 1 + 3. Ben can you run rollback? I'll prepare fail-open.

ben.kim: running rollback now:
```
ku bectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/quota-mapper --to-revision=3
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=quota-mapper -w
```

ben.kim: rollback applied. pods are coming up.

alice-nguyen: applying fail-open flag to rate-limiter: 
```
kubectl -n prod patch configmap rate-limiter-config -p '{"data":{"fail_mode":"open-temporary"}}'
```

alice-nguyen: fail-open in place, routing to fallback limiter. traffic is moving through. 429s dropping.

maria-ps: customer impact: based on logs we saw ~420k requests in window 12:02-12:10, 8,900 429 responses (~2.1%). Affected customers: 33 tenants saw elevated error rates, one high-volume tenant (acme-inc) saw 6% errors.

product-ops: flagged acme-inc and submitted support ticket. Notifying account team.

sre-oncall: monitoring metrics. 429 rate returning to baseline. keeping PD incident open for 30m to ensure stability.

pagerduty: INC-2026-4897 status: acknowledged by @sre-oncall. Escalation paused.

lucas-g: quick post-check: no further KeyError after rollback. replicated locally with failing header — config validation should've caught this. will add schema validation.

ben.kim: adding validation now and will open PR to gate config changes via CI. also will add a canary percentage for config rollout.

alice-nguyen: manual mitigation steps documented in the runbook. adding note: when toggling fail-open, remember to set timer and alert on elevated 5xx.

sre-oncall: handing off to next oncall @maria-ps at 13:00. summary: root cause faulty quota-mapper config that dropped x-tenant-id, caused KeyError -> quota misapply -> 429 spike. Mitigation: rollback to revision 3, enable fail-open for 10m, monitor. Customer impact: 33 tenants, peak 6% for acme-inc, overall 2.1% requests affected. Follow-ups: config schema validation, canary gating, alert tuning. assigning follow-ups to @ben.kim and @lucas-g.

maria-ps: ack, will monitor and own postmortem draft.

sre-oncall: closing slack thread for live ops. :white_check_mark: we'll update PD once incident is resolved fully.

pagerduty: Incident INC-2026-4897 marked as resolved by @sre-oncall at 13:05. :tada:

product-ops: thanks everyone. please add timeline and RCA to the incident doc.
